action: Residents: be cautious with unexpected e-mails, SMS or calls; the municipality says it never asks for passwords, account details or payments by phone, SMS or e-mail. Report suspicious messages to the Rathaus or the police.
date_note: Date of the municipality's announcement of dark web monitoring, as published by noe.ORF.at on 21 Nov 2026; the attack itself was at the end of July, per noe.ORF.at on 22 Oct 2026.
exec: A municipality offers dark web monitoring to residents after a July cyberattack affected citizens' data.
plain: The Austrian municipality of Reichenau an der Rax, hit by a cyberattack at the end of July, offers affected people personal dark web monitoring and an information evening on 23 November.

sources.name: noe.ORF.at: Cyberangriff in Reichenau: Monitoring für Betroffene
noe.ORF.at: Cyberangriff: Große Datenmengen im Darknet gelandet

summary: noe.ORF.at reports that the municipality of Reichenau an der Rax offers everyone affected a personal dark web monitoring, after a cyberattack at the end of July. The municipality says it learned only in October that data of many citizens was also affected, and no damage is known, according to the mayor. It has filed a criminal complaint and informed the data protection authority; ORF says the ransomware group SafePay was apparently involved.
title: Reichenau an der Rax municipality offers dark web monitoring after cyberattack

validation.note: Only noe.ORF.at (reports of 22 Oct and 21 Nov 2026) relaying the municipality's statements; no second publisher or municipal page read. SafePay involvement is ORF's 'apparently', not confirmed.
